answer: Corundum keeps its delivery audit events, which are the history used to investigate missing parcels, for 63 days. Iona Park is the policy steward responsible for this rule. A separate rule keeps anonymous weekly trend totals for 18 months, and that rule does not extend how long the raw events are kept. I found no conflicting or newer record.
limitations: This rests on one page, wiki/event-ledger.md (updated 2026-10-24). The page calls Iona Park the 'policy steward' and does not say whether she is also the approver or the person who carries the rule out. The ops-* pages give other retention periods for other services (for example, ops-043 says Dune keeps sample audit events for 63 days). None of them mention Corundum, so they do not conflict with this answer.
